new_value: OpenAI confidentially filed a draft S-1 with the SEC on June 8, 2026, at an $852B valuation; timing undecided. Follows Anthropic's June 1 filing.
headline: OpenAI files confidential S-1, following Anthropic into the IPO race within a week
so_what: Retires 'Anthropic beat OpenAI to the IPO filing' as a durable differentiator (OpenAI filed within a week), so reps should drop filing-order bragging. More importantly, both labs' financials (cash burn, margins) are now headed for public disclosure; prep buyers for the financial-discipline comparison rather than valuation-race talking points.

new_value: A coalition of state AGs led by New York subpoenaed OpenAI on June 12, 2026, investigating advertising, user engagement/retention, consumer and health data, and treatment of minors and seniors, days after its IPO filing.
headline: State AG coalition opens consumer-harm investigation into OpenAI on eve of its IPO
so_what: When an OpenAI-leaning buyer cites Anthropic's regulatory scars (federal blacklisting) to paint us as the risky vendor, reps can counter that OpenAI is now under a multi-state AG subpoena over consumer harm, minors, and health data right as it files to go public, flipping the trust-and-governance argument.

new_value: OpenAI is acquiring Ona (ex-Gitpod) to run Codex agents in hosted cloud environments for longer, multi-step tasks. Announced June 11, 2026; terms undisclosed, deal not yet closed.
headline: OpenAI buys Ona (ex-Gitpod) to give Codex long-running cloud agents
so_what: In any deal that turns on background or async agent execution, expect Codex to soon pitch hosted, long-running agents. Counter now by noting the capability is acquired and unshipped (deal not closed yet), while Claude Code already ships Dynamic Workflows and managed agents for codebase-scale parallel runs.
